name: distance_between_points_xz

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DistanceBetweenPointsXz reads four stack values, computes sqrt((x2 - x1)^2 + (z2 - z1)^2), decrements stackTop by three, and replaces the remaining first value with the integer distance

notes: The direct stackTop decrement alone resembles a three-input command, but the handler reads four values and leaves one result, so the observable contract is four inputs and one output. The JP corpus contains 193 calls.
